# IT3 Consultants

> IT3 Consultants is a Belgian IT consultancy founded by Gratien D'haese,
> specializing in Linux/Unix infrastructure, disaster recovery, and open-source
> software. It is the home of Relax-and-Recover (ReaR), the leading open-source
> bare-metal disaster recovery framework for Linux, and cfg2html.

## Company

- [Company](https://it3.be/company/): About IT3 Consultants, services and expertise
- [About](https://it3.be/about/): Background on Gratien D'haese and the company
- [Contact](https://it3.be/contact/): Contact information (info@it3.be)
- [Privacy](https://it3.be/privacy/): Privacy policy

## Open Source Projects

- [Projects overview](https://it3.be/projects/): All open-source projects
- [Relax-and-Recover (ReaR)](https://it3.be/projects/rear/): Linux bare-metal disaster recovery and system migration framework
- [ReaR User Guide](https://it3.be/projects/rear-user-guide/): Official user documentation for ReaR
- [ReaR Automated Testing](https://it3.be/projects/rear-automated-testing/): Automated testing setup for ReaR
- [ReaR Support](https://it3.be/rear-support/index.html): Commercial support options for ReaR
- [cfg2html](https://it3.be/projects/cfg2html/): System configuration documentation collector for Linux/HP-UX
- [Upgrade-UX](https://it3.be/projects/upgrade-ux/): Framework to upgrade and patch Unix systems
- [GitHub](https://github.com/gdha): Source code repositories
